description.value:
One shot, placed exactly. The scrap-rifle culture's answer to a world where ammunition is worth more than the people carrying it.

SIGNATURE — bonus precision damage against your Marked quarry, scaling as the Mark holds longer.

cinderfall.incomplete: This is exactly Ranger's Precision classfeature's shape (P4: DamageDice category "precision", gated on target:mark:<slug>, formula scaling on a tracked variable) — real and buildable once (a) the Mark exists and (b) this card's own text states the actual scaling numbers/formula it currently omits ("scaling as the Mark holds longer" isn't a formula). The Waywarden's central subsystem, The Mark (classes.waywarden.json flags.cinderfall.terms[0]: "designate a creature as your quarry, gaining a growing bonus to track, target, and punish it specifically"), has zero Foundry-schema footprint anywhere in the corpus. classes.waywarden.json:65 itself carries "rules": []. No card anywhere grants a TokenMark effect (site/data/cards/abilities/, class-features/, feat-effects/ are all empty scaffold directories -- confirmed via ls, contents are .gitkeep only). Real pf2e's own equivalent mechanic (Ranger's Hunt Prey) is fully buildable and precedented, but that infrastructure (an action item + a TokenMark-carrying effect item) does not exist for Waywarden and is not one of the 56 files in scope for this draft. This card is blocked until a future pass authors the base Mark action/effect.
